reason: The cited lines show the tool fetching pull request data from a Git API via an established connection and returning it to the agent/user, which supports SECRET because repository/pull-request data from a SaaS Git service may be non-public. That returned pull request/query data can include user-controlled PR content, so UNTRUSTED is supported. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution. They also do not show sending agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination; the API calls are read/query calls to the Git service, not a SINK as defined.
